title: pvNetCDFPOPreader
body:
## pvNetCDFPOPreader

Reads Parallel Ocean Program (POP) NetCDF output into a rectilinear grid. The NetCDF x, y, z order becomes the grid's z, y, x order, and z coordinates are negated so the first level is the highest (depth downwards). Only three-dimensional variables are offered; Stride subsamples the grid. Use pvNetCDFReader for general CF-convention files and pvParallelNetCDFPOPreader for the parallel variant.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Index order is reversed relative to the NetCDF variable; apply Stride in grid (i, j, k) order.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `NetCDFPOPreader`. Identity: `sources/NetCDFPOPReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Stride` | This property indicate the number of indices per dimension (i,j,k) to skip between each point included in this output. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `VariableArrayStatus` | Names of the NetCDF variables to load as arrays on the rectilinear grid; only three-dimensional variables are offered by the reader. Listing names is exclusive: ParaView switches every other available name off, so include all you need; an empty list reads none. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvNetCDFPOPreader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
